intro.narration: [excited] Heey — three percent of a hundred twenty-five? [pause] Flip it.

steps.narration: [curious] Three percent of a hundred twenty-five looks awkward.
[confident] But A percent of B always equals B percent of A. [pause] Swap them.
steps.working: a% of b = b% of a

steps.narration: [excited] So do the easy side: a hundred twenty-five percent of three. That's three, plus three quarters.
[confident] Which is three point seven five. [pause] Read it straight back.
[thoughtful] One catch — this is "of", not "off". [pause] Twenty percent off fifty is forty, but fifty percent off twenty is ten.
